```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import umap
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
import time

# 1. Data Extraction & Preparation 

print("Loading MNIST dataset...")
# Adding parser='auto' prevents the silent network hang
mnist = fetch_openml('mnist_784', version=1, as_frame=True, parser='auto')
X_df = mnist.data
y_series = mnist.target.astype(int)

print(f"Features DataFrame shape: {X_df.shape}")
print("\nFirst 5 rows of the dataset:")
print(X_df.head())
```

```{python}
# 2. Dimensionality Reduction

reducer = umap.UMAP(
    n_neighbors=15, 
    min_dist=0.1, 
    metric='euclidean', 
    random_state=42 
)

print("\nRunning UMAP optimization on massive dataset...")
start_time = time.time()

embedding = reducer.fit_transform(X_df.values) 

execution_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"UMAP Execution time: {execution_time:.2f} seconds")


```

```{python}
embedding_df = pd.DataFrame(embedding, columns=['UMAP_1', 'UMAP_2'])
embedding_df['label'] = y_series.values

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = ax.scatter(
    embedding_df['UMAP_1'], 
    embedding_df['UMAP_2'], 
    c=embedding_df['label'], 
    cmap='Spectral', 
    s=0.1 
)

cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, boundaries=np.arange(11)-0.5)
cbar.set_ticks(np.arange(10))
ax.set_title('UMAP Projection of the MNIST Dataset (n=70,000)', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('UMAP Dimension 1')
ax.set_ylabel('UMAP Dimension 2')


plt.show()
```
